description: Chart-driven guideline triggers. Each rule fires when any matcher in `any` matches a fact or the problem list (or every matcher in `all` does), and no matcher in `exclude` does. Matchers: {category, loinc[], direction?} on lab facts; {category, drug_regex} on medication facts; {category, vital} on vital facts; {problem_regex} against active problem titles; {age_below|age_above|age_between} against the patient's age (an unknown age never satisfies an `all` age matcher and never fires an `exclude` age matcher); {category_present[], loinc[]} true when any fact of those categories carries that LOINC. `source` must be a document in sidecar/corpus/manifest.json; `query` is the fixed retrieval query the sidecar embeds at index build. Every rule is a clinical decision: cite the reasoning in `note`.

rules.label: Cholesterol management
rules.query: statin indication and intensity when LDL cholesterol is above goal
rules.note: 2018 AHA/ACC primary-prevention statin recommendations apply to ages 40-75.

rules.label: Diabetes care
rules.query: individualized A1c goal for adults with type 2 diabetes and frequency of A1c testing
rules.note: ADA glycemic targets are for nonpregnant adults with type 2 diabetes.

rules.label: Blood pressure
rules.query: blood pressure target and treatment threshold in adults
rules.note: 2017 ACC/AHA adult classification and treatment thresholds.

rules.label: Anemia
rules.note: Adult, non-pregnant work-up; a high hemoglobin is not anemia.

rules.label: Kidney function
rules.query: CKD staging and monitoring by eGFR and albuminuria
rules.note: KDIGO 2024 staging by eGFR; a raised creatinine or reduced eGFR or a CKD diagnosis.

rules.label: Diabetes screening
rules.query: USPSTF recommendation on screening asymptomatic adults aged 35 to 70 with overweight or obesity for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes
rules.note: USPSTF 2021: adults 35-70 with overweight or obesity; not for people with diabetes or with a recent A1c. The briefing's facts cover results since the prior visit, so 'recent' means an A1c in this briefing.
